LEARN VOID / 05

Control flow

Follow the logic.

Conditions, loops and explicit exits.

Choose a branch

Use if, else if and else with Boolean conditions. In this program, the first loop uses continue to skip even numbers.

One loop keyword

for index < limit: repeats while its condition is true. A bare for: repeats until the body exits. break ends a loop, while continue starts its next iteration.

With input 5, the first loop totals the odd numbers 1 + 3 + 5 = 9. The second adds three until the total reaches 21.

Iterate through a collection

A collection loop uses for item in items:. Add an index with for item, index in items:. See the collections guide for a complete program.
